trials.claim: Lifetime access to SmatLeads with all future Starter Plan updates
trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to SmatLeads
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future Starter Plan updates
trials.reasoning: A lifetime buyer is told Unified Inbox is only available on a paid plan and to upgrade to unlock it, which materially limits the promise of lifetime access with all future Starter Plan updates.

exhibits.quote: I am on the maximum Tier 5 plan. An addition to the developer's response: I have no reason to lie; I didn't buy this product just to leave a review.
exhibits.argument: Buyer on maximum tier reports being asked to pay extra, undermining lifetime access with all future updates.

exhibits.quote: Unified Inbox is only available on a paid plan. Upgrade your plan to unlock this feature and many more.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime buyer is blocked from features behind a paid upgrade, contradicting all future updates included.

exhibits.quote: The tool was already good, and now that it has been updated, I can see it has become even better.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms the buyer received platform updates after purchase.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes 5,000 credits per month for GBP, Bing, and LinkedIn leads searches
trials.claimQuote: 5,000 credits per month for GBP, Bing, and LinkedIn leads searches
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report a very small search limit, including waiting 15 hours after 3 searches, preventing them from actually using the promised 5,000 monthly credits.

exhibits.quote: they implemented a very small search limit after we purchased so there is no way we could even use the credits
exhibits.argument: Daily search limit prevents buyers from actually using the promised monthly credits.

exhibits.quote: Very restrictive, after 3 searches, you have to wait 15 hours before you can search again
exhibits.argument: Three-search daily cap makes 5,000 credits per month unreachable in practice.

trials.claim: Plan 2 includes 10,000 credits per month for GBP, Bing, and LinkedIn leads searches
trials.claimQuote: 10,000 credits per month for GBP, Bing, and LinkedIn leads searches
trials.reasoning: A Tier 2 buyer reports only about 650 total per month instead of 10,000, and another reports credits are never available.

exhibits.quote: We have a Tier 2 liscence that claims up to 10,000 emails/month - and we are averaging 60 - 120 per search and a total volume 650 PER MONTH.
exhibits.argument: Tier 2 buyer reports only 650 total per month instead of promised 10,000.

exhibits.quote: No matter how many times we take a run at the search. The credits are NEVER Available.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports credits are never available, directly undermining the 10,000 credits claim.

trials.claim: Find high-paying, easy-to-close leads for local business or agency
trials.claimQuote: Find high-paying, easy-to-close leads for your local business or agency
trials.reasoning: Reviews conflict: some buyers call the results questionable, bad and unusable, while others report booking meetings and finding local opportunities, so lead quality cannot be confirmed either way.

exhibits.quote: I tried the GBP search tool several times and it what it returns is questionable at best.
exhibits.argument: Buyer finds search results questionable, undermining high-paying easy-to-close leads claim.

exhibits.quote: In short, the results you get from this are pretty bad and unusable.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports results are bad and unusable, contradicting valuable lead quality promise.

exhibits.quote: After just a little over one month of using SmatLeads, I booked five meetings with potential clients in a single week.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms the tool delivered client meetings for the buyer's business.

exhibits.quote: I've been using SmartLeads as part of my business consulting practice, and it's become a valuable tool for finding new opportunities in my local market.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms the tool finds local market opportunities for a business practice.

trials.claim: Export leads as CSV or PDF file
trials.claimQuote:
Manage leads
- Export leads as CSV or PDF file
- Report customization
- Marvis AI (AI writing assistant)
trials.reasoning: Reviews conflict on export: one buyer says they cannot export at all and another says exports lose project categories, while another confirms CSV and PDF export options work.

exhibits.quote: Barely works, emails don't verify and can't even export leads LOL what a joke.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports export does not work at all, contradicting CSV or PDF export claim.

exhibits.quote: However, SmatLeads dumps all your leads into one massive list on export, completely stripping out the project categories you carefully organized them into.
exhibits.argument: Export strips project categories, undermining promised lead export functionality.

exhibits.quote: It also does basic reporting well with options to export to CSV and PDF.
exhibits.argument: The quote confirms export to CSV and PDF works as promised.

exhibits.argument: Buyer could not connect email to send campaigns, undermining built-in email sender claim.

exhibits.quote: This creates a disconnect in the sending tool, making it impossible to send campaigns.
exhibits.argument: Email routing bug makes it impossible to send campaigns with the built-in sender.
